items.title: DittoDub Launches New Native 6 AI Dubbing Model With Support for Over 100 Languages
items.rationale: Concrete model release. Native 6 recreates an original speaker's performance in 109 languages, which directly changes how creators localise their work.
items.excerpt: More AI tools and dubbing options are on the way, and this new one from the team at DittoDub will let creators or teams recreate an original speaker’s performance in 109 different languages.

items.title: We're making it easier to identify AI-generated content globally.
items.rationale: Official launch of a standalone SynthID detector that checks whether video or images came from Google or partner AI tools. This is a concrete provenance check for footage and an answer to the 'prove you didn't use AI' question.
items.excerpt: We’re launching a standalone platform to help you easily identify whether online content was created using Google AI or tools from our industry partners.

items.title: Abundantia Entertainment To Turn AI Arm AiOn Into Standalone Studio
items.rationale: Corporate decision: an established Indian producer is spinning its AI creative arm out as a standalone production studio, a sign that AI production is becoming its own business line.
items.excerpt: India's Abundantia Entertainment is moving to turn its AI creative arm Abundantia AiOn into a standalone production studio.

items.title: AI Studio Authors First, Backed by $10 Million, Pledges to Help Writers Faithfully Adapt Their Books
items.rationale: New $10M AI studio launch with an author-controlled model, in which sci-fi and fantasy writers adapt their own books. This is a new path from book IP to screen.
items.excerpt: Authors First, founded by venture capitalist Robert Hamwee, promises to let science-fiction and fantasy scribes adapt their titles as closely to their intended vision as possible

items.title: Worried About AI Training on Your Videos? This Platform Lets You Protect and Monetize Your Work
items.rationale: New platform launch. Sinima gives filmmakers protection, visibility and licensing control over uploaded work that AI could otherwise train on, which they can act on right away.
items.excerpt: A look at Sinima, a new Creative Ownership Platform that aims to give filmmakers and creatives new levels of protection, visibility, and control over the work they upload online.
